signatures_note.original_script: Актъ сей ... прочитанъ, нами и ими подписанъ

translation: Took place in posad Serock, 9 October 1890 at 12 noon. Appeared personally Icek Przykorski, [ritual slaughterer?], 26, and Gerszon Wielkobroda, baker, 32, both residing in posad Serock, and declared: that on the 8th of October of this year died a child, at 9 PM, of female sex, without a name, six days old, daughter of Abram and Cyrka, the Goldsztejn spouses. Upon eyewitness certification of the death of the child, this act was read and signed by us and by them.
